module cmt_mod (
	input wire 			clk,
	input wire 			clk2400,
	input wire 			din,
	output reg			cmt_out
	);

	reg	_clk2400;
	
	always @( posedge clk) begin

		if( clk2400 & ~_clk2400)			cmt_out <= ~cmt_out;
		if( ~clk2400 & _clk2400 & din)	cmt_out <= ~cmt_out;

		_clk2400 <= clk2400;
	end

endmodule
